preconditions.description: The number of tests is between 1 and 10^3 inclusive.
The size of the initial square for each test is 2^n_i x 2^n_i.
The number of splitting operations for each test is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if it's possible to perform exactly k_i splitting operations such that the condition of Olya's happiness is satisfied, otherwise output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: if YES, output the log_2 of the side length of the squares on the path
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then also output the logarithm base 2 of the side length of the squares through which the path from the lower left to the upper right can be built.

invariants.expression: the initial square size is 2^n_i x 2^n_i
invariants.description: The initial square size is always 2^n_i x 2^n_i, where n_i is the input for the i-th test.

invariants.expression: the number of splitting operations is k_i
invariants.description: The number of splitting operations is exactly k_i, where k_i is the input for the i-th test.
